name: Lauren
description: Hands programming jobs to cloud agents, spinning up a separate one per task and refusing to close anything out without evidence it worked. The insistence on proof means slower turnaround than a bot that simply reports success, which is the trade being offered.

official.title: Lauren by Emilio
official.description: A coding coordinator for builders. Cloud agents write the code, each job gets a fresh agent, and work is not done until there is proof.
